Previous posts have looked at the range of zoning in the city of Franklin and how much property the city owns. This post will look at some of these properties over time to understand changing assessments and the tax cap. The data for this post come from the nh tax associate, the online portal used to pay taxes. I gathered this data in late 2025, so it may have changed since then, but I believe it is complete enough for this analysis. This post will not name individual property owners, instead it will examine, in aggregate, the changes in assessment. 

```{r read in data}

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(gt)
library(tmap)
tmap_mode("view")
better_zone_map<- read_sf(here::here(".data/outputs/parcel_nums_with_zone.shp")) 

zone_sf<- read_sf(here::here(".data/20251116_geo_dat/zone_polys.shp")) 

a<- zone_sf %>% st_zm() %>% st_transform(st_crs(better_zone_map)) %>% 
    group_by(NAME) %>% 
    filter(LABEL == "DROD"| LABEL =="LP")

lakes_and_hist<- st_intersection(better_zone_map, a) %>% filter(PARCEL_ != "000-000-00") %>% filter(PARCEL_ != "000-WATER-00") %>%
    mutate(lead_3 = str_sub(PARCEL_, start = 1, end =3)) %>%
    mutate(group = if_else(lead_3<100, "Lake", "Downtown"))%>%
    group_by(PARCEL_) %>%
    slice(1)

lakes_and_hist %>% qtm()

ts_raw<- read_csv(here::here(".data/assess_ts_comb.csv"))

ts_dat<- ts_raw %>%
    select(PARCEL_, `Bill Amount`, `Due Date`) %>%
    janitor::clean_names()%>%
    mutate(due_date= mdy(due_date))

comb<- lakes_and_hist%>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(PARCEL_, NAME, LABEL, group)%>% distinct() %>% 
    left_join(ts_dat, join_by(PARCEL_==parcel)) 
annual<-comb %>%
    mutate(year= year(due_date)) %>%
    group_by(group, PARCEL_, year) %>%
    summarize(annual_tax= sum(bill_amount)) 

annual %>% ggplot(aes(y =annual_tax, x = year, group= PARCEL_)) + 
    geom_line(alpha=.3) + 
    facet_grid(rows=vars(group))    

annual %>%
    group_by(group, year) %>%
    summarize(mean_tax = mean(annual_tax, na.rm=T), 
    tot_tax= sum(annual_tax, na.rm=T))%>%
        ggplot(aes(x=year, y = mean_tax, color= group)) +
        geom_line() 



annual %>%
    group_by(group, year) %>%
    summarize(mean_tax = mean(annual_tax, na.rm=T), 
    tot_tax= sum(annual_tax, na.rm=T))%>%
        ggplot(aes(x=year, y = tot_tax, color= group)) +
        geom_line() + 
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency())  +
                labs(title = "Total Tax", 
        x = NULL, 
        y = NULL) + 
            theme_bw()


annual %>%
    group_by(group, year) %>%
    summarize(mean_tax = mean(annual_tax, na.rm=T), 
    tot_tax= sum(annual_tax, na.rm=T))%>% 
        #write_csv(here::here(".data/outputs/annual_group_tax.csv"))
        ggplot(aes(x=year, y = mean_tax, color= group)) +
        geom_line() + 
        scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency())  + 
        labs(title = "Average Annual Tax", 
        x = NULL, 
        y = NULL) + 
            theme_bw()



```
